summary: Recover adjacent registry-ahead versions in auto mode

delivery.outcome: Goal auto mode safely recovers only a uniform local version exactly one patch behind its registry baseline
nonGoals: No recovery for manual execution, non-adjacent gaps or inconsistent local carriers
No version metadata or dependency change
No push, merge, publication or global installation

architecture.decision: Gate adjacent registry repair behind an explicit resolver flag supplied only from the all-flags push context
architecture.rollback: Revert the resolver flag, push propagation and focused tests; strict registry-ahead rejection remains the baseline

validation.evidence: adjacent auto release and no-release decisions select the registry baseline
manual, non-adjacent and inconsistent cases fail closed
push workflow forwards the repair permission only from all_flags

commands: ruff check goal/cli/version_state.py goal/push/core.py goal/push/stages/version.py tests/test_version_state.py tests/test_push_e2e.py
validation.evidence: focused, full, lint, governance, package and container checks pass
